Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Can you play Infernal Pursuit at superior at any time during combat?

1) You're acting. You declare a card strike and draw up Infernal
Pursuit. Can you play it after you declare strikes but before your
opponent does? (You're digging for Psyche!) [Yes?]

2) You draw it up after playing a damage prevention card. Can you play
it digging for another DP card? [Yes?]

3) You're reacting. Your opponent plays Illusions of the Kindred. Can
you play it digging for a Direct Intervention? [No?]

4) You just Amaranthed your opponent and draw up Infernal Pursuit. Can
you play it and hope for a Ritual of the Bitter Rose? [Yes?]

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeff Kuta wrote:
> Can you play Infernal Pursuit at superior at any time during combat?

Yes.

> 1) You're acting. You declare a card strike and draw up Infernal
> Pursuit. Can you play it after you declare strikes but before your
> opponent does? (You're digging for Psyche!) [Yes?]

Yes.

> 2) You draw it up after playing a damage prevention card. Can you play
> it digging for another DP card? [Yes?]

Yes.

> 3) You're reacting. Your opponent plays Illusions of the Kindred. Can
> you play it digging for a Direct Intervention? [No?]

Correct. You can't play it "as" IotK is played. By the time you play it,
IotK will have been played, which means it is too late to DI the IotK.

> 4) You just Amaranthed your opponent and draw up Infernal Pursuit. Can
> you play it and hope for a Ritual of the Bitter Rose? [Yes?]

Correct.
